# Limited to Limitless™ — Lisa Murphy, MBA

> Keynote speaker and business consultant. Former COO, 20+ years in leadership.
> Helps leaders whose companies are "successful on the surface, breaking apart
> underneath" by diagnosing the real margin-and-structure problem, installing the
> system inside the operation, and handing the team the controls.

## About Lisa
Lisa Murphy, MBA — founder of Limited to Limitless™. A former COO with 20+ years of
leadership experience who has stood inside real operations, not just advised on them.
She diagnoses from the operation out, never from a template.

## Core idea (her IP)
What looks like a time problem is really a margin-and-structure problem in a time
costume. Everyone treats it as a scheduling issue and throws more hours at it; the
hours disappear and the problem stays, because the leak was never in the calendar.
Lisa opens the doors and walks through them with you until the system is installed
and the team runs it without her.

## What she does
- Diagnose the real leak — margin and structure, not the calendar
- Install the system inside your actual operation
- Sit in the driver's seat with you until it holds
- Do the belief work, then hand the team the controls

## What she does not do
- Drop a binder and bail
- Sell hype, hacks, or motivation for its own sake
- Work with retail or quick-fix, hype-seeking buyers
- Leave you dependent on her to keep it running

## The path
Diagnose → install the system → driver's seat → belief work → leave the team able to hold it.
